result.description: COL BROS PETROLEUM PTY LTD  COL BROS PETROLEUM PTY LTD, trading as Metro South Windsor, is looking for an experienced and proactive Retail Manager to lead the day-to-day operations of our busy petrol station and convenience store in South Windsor, NSW.  This is an excellent opportunity for a capable retail professional to take ownership of store operations, lead and develop a dedicated team, optimise sales performance, maintain inventory and merchandising standards, and ensure exceptional customer service while supporting the ongoing growth of the business.   Benefits      Competitive annual salary of AUD $80,000–$85,000 plus Superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.  Full-time permanent position offering long-term career stability.  Supportive and collaborative work environment with an established retail business.  Opportunities for ongoing training, professional development and career progression.  Exposure to all aspects of retail and convenience store management in a dynamic and customer-focused environment.  Employee support from an experienced management team.  Opportunity to contribute to the continued growth and success of a well-established petrol station and convenience store.    Task & responsibilities   Plan, organise and oversee the daily operations of the petrol station and convenience store.  Lead, supervise, train and support retail staff to ensure efficient store operations and high customer service standards.  Prepare employee rosters, allocate duties and monitor staff performance.  Manage inventory levels, stock ordering, merchandising and supplier coordination to maintain product availability.  Monitor fuel and retail sales performance and implement strategies to improve sales and profitability.  Ensure accurate cash handling, banking procedures, daily reconciliations and point-of-sale (POS) operations.  Resolve customer enquiries and complaints professionally while maintaining high service standards.  Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, fuel handling procedures, food safety standards and company policies.  Monitor store presentation, merchandising displays and cleanliness to maximise customer experience.  Prepare operational reports and assist with budgeting, cost control and business performance monitoring.  Keep abreast of market trends to determine the need for improvements in the store.  Analyze sales and revenue reports and make forecasts.  Ensure the store fulfils all legal health and safety guidelines.  Determine product mix, stock levels, and service standards.  Formulate and implement purchasing and marketing policies and set prices.  Promote and advertise the establishment’s goods and services.  Sell goods and services to customers and advise them on product use.  Maintain records of stock levels and financial transactions.  Undertake budgeting for the establishment.    Qualification & experience      Relevant qualification in Retail Management, Business, Management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.  1–2 years of relevant experience in a retail management or supervisory role within a customer-focused retail environment.  Demonstrated ability to plan, organise and coordinate retail operations to achieve business objectives.  Strong leadership, people management and staff supervision skills, with the ability to motivate and develop a high-performing team.  Experience in inventory management, stock control, merchandising and supplier coordination.  Sound knowledge of point-of-sale (POS) systems, cash handling and retail operational procedures.  Excellent communication, interpersonal and customer service skills.  Strong organisational, analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.  Sound understanding of workplace health and safety, retail compliance requirements and operational best practices.
